_comment: src/assets/objects/fire_drill.png を作り直すためのレシピ。build.py が読む。
きりもみ式の火起こし具。板と心棒の2つで1組（src/world-codex/fire.yaml）。
**板だけを生成し、穴・切り欠き・心棒は編集で足す。** 一度に頼むと道具そのものが出てこない
（prompts/objects.json の fire_drill 参照）。**足す物は編集のほうが強い**——生成で言うと
文全体の解釈が変わってしまうが、編集は今ある絵を保ったまま描き足せる。
枠は横長（1152x896）。板の隣に心棒を寝かせる場所が要る。
段は400。板が長いので、太い枝と同じ幅まで使う（1200ml）。

edit.prompt: Repaint this picture as a soft hand painted illustration on a plain empty white page. Keep the same flat wooden board in the same place at the same angle, but make it a rough piece of dry bare wood instead of polished furniture: paint it with soft brush strokes, visible grain and slightly ragged edges. Burn one small round black hole into the face of the board near its front edge, and cut a narrow V shaped notch into that edge leading into the hole. Lay one plain straight round wooden stick, as thick as a finger and about as long as the board, on the page in front of the board, resting on the page and not touching the board. Change the wood to a warm mid brown, clearly darker than the white page. Remove the background completely and replace it with a plain empty white page, leaving the board and the stick alone in the middle with a wide white margin all around them and one soft grey shadow beneath each of them. Dry matte surface, flat even lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature.
